'''Manda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] as a contact for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While hanging out in the local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], another operative was directed to Manda by [[Minder Twenty]]. The operative was given a gambling chip, and sent to speak to a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Unidentified Chiss security officer|security officer]].<ref name="TOR" />
